prompt:
The section sections/brand-story.liquid has correct markup, but its {% schema %} JSON was pasted from a document and many string values have stray leading or trailing spaces. This applies to ids, option values, defaults, labels and names, and it breaks lookups such as section.settings.image_position. The markup reads section.settings.eyebrow, heading, story, image, image_position, button_link and button_label. Do not change the markup. Replace the schema JSON so that it is exactly this schema, with no leading or trailing whitespace in any string. Key order does not matter. - name: "Brand story"; tag: "section"; class: "brand-story". - settings, in this order: 1. type "text", id "eyebrow", label "Eyebrow", default "Since 1998". 2. type "text", id "heading", label "Heading", default "Our story". 3. type "richtext", id "story", label "Story", default "

We started in a small workshop.

". The text inside the

element must not have spaces at its start or end. 4. type "image_picker", id "image", label "Image". It has no default. 5. type "select", id "image_position", label "Image position", options [{value "left", label "Left"}, {value "right", label "Right"}], default "left". 6. type "url", id "button_link", label "Button link". It has no default. 7. type "text", id "button_label", label "Button label", default "Read more". - presets: exactly one preset, {name "Brand story"}, with no other keys. - The schema has no blocks and no max_blocks key. Do not add any other keys. Change only sections/brand-story.liquid. Do not suppress checks or hardcode case values. All input keys are present.
